evidence_items.explanation: The May–June survey reports that 68% of respondents' organizations had moved no more than 30% of experiments fully into production, and 41% struggled to measure their impacts. This supports an experimentation-to-deployment gap but does not count publicly documented successes.

Klarna published a specific operational improvement for its OpenAI-powered customer-service assistant. This is a company-reported success story, not independent verification or evidence that such stories were common.

Production conversion is not the same measure as documented success.
